_comment: sc-19057 standalone capture plan for the FIRST candle video lane, candle:wan2_2_ti2v_5b. Deliberately NOT in config/memory-calibration-plan.json, for the reason sc-18808 established empirically for mlx:ltx_2_3: generate-memory-matrix.mjs resolves its coordinate universe from manifest.models.filter(m => m.type === "image"), so a video plan row matches no coordinate and assertCalibrationPlanTargetsResolvedCoordinates fails the check gate closed. Drive it with: node scripts/memory-calibration-harness.mjs run --config docs/calibration/sc-19057/wan-candle-video-capture-plan.json --backend candle --fresh-per-case --provider-command '["<target>/release/memory-candle-adapter.exe"]' --sceneworks-repo <repo> --inference-repo <inference-at-pin> --output <OUTSIDE the repo>.json. Do NOT add --raw-log-dir/--source-path-prefix: the harness's raw-log arm requires a provider sourceCapture of kind physical_mlx, only bin/mlx.rs emits one, and bin/candle.rs emits none - so the pair aborts this lane, after the first row's cold model load. Full procedure, environment and verification: docs/calibration-runbook.md section 12d.
_targetFamily: candle-gen-wan is the ONLY candle video crate that registers a MemoryStrategyContract at inference 6f47e670 (memory_strategy::MEMORY_REGISTRATION, SC-19223). candle-gen-ltx registers none at all, so an LTX capture would have no admission seam to interrogate and no calibration identity to bind. See the sc-19057 header comment in crates/sceneworks-memory-adapter/src/bin/candle.rs.
_geometry: Six rows spanning TWO pixel counts x THREE frame counts, so the three-coefficient cross form (fixed + per-mpx + per-mpx-frame) is identifiable: with one pixel count the design matrix is rank 2 and fit-ltx-temporal-form.mjs reports a singular slice. Rows are ordered cheapest-first; the fitter needs at least three distinct non-collinear geometry points plus at least one held-out row, so the last row may be dropped if the lane budget is exceeded and the remaining five still fit.
_cadence: fps is fixed at 24 on every row. limits.fps declares [16, 24], but WanMemoryRequestScope::validate_request rejects any cadence other than DEFAULT_FPS, so the 16 fps column is shipped and not capturable. The arm refuses a 16 fps fixture by name rather than letting it die inside the provider.
_tier: q4 is the default:true candle download variant for windows/linux and the tier minMemoryGb 14 gates. q8 is a second campaign run from a copy of this plan placed OUTSIDE the checkout (same rule as --output) with the tier and fixture tokens swapped in that copy, never in place: an uncommitted swap here dirties the tree the harness is attesting to via git status --porcelain and the sweep is discarded at check, and a committed swap reds the plan-tier gate in scripts/platform-review-contracts.test.mjs that pins every row's target.tier to the default candle variant. bf16 is out of scope because that tier is the upstream dense Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers snapshot, which carries no per-tier subdirectory for validate_huggingface_snapshot_root to bind an artifact identity to. Full procedure: docs/calibration-runbook.md section 12d.
_evidenceScope: authoritative, matching the mlx:ltx_2_3 video precedent (docs/generated/ltx-mlx-video-sc-18808.json) so the two video lanes are directly comparable. sc-18808's review left open whether a first-of-its-kind video record is entitled to that over "candidate"; the answer taken here is that it is, because the receipt carries executed admission scenarios rather than a blocked seam.
